beer.beer_description: Fries is a brand new West Coast IPA, brewed especially to celebrate Range turning eight! Now every good meal needs a salty palate cleanser to cut through the intensity and while this Westy isn't salty, it sure does hit the spot amongst the haze. Hopped heavily with Chinook, Eclipse, Maui Nelson Hopkief, and Nelson Sauvin, it's really the perfect balance of old school citrus and pine mixed with new school dank and Kiwi saturation. In the glass, a stunning light straw colour with an impressive clarity thanks to a 100% Premium Pilsner malt base. Aromas coming through dominated by crispy orange citrus and a hint of dark berry priming the palate for what's to come. Take a sip and you'll find the crispest of palates, super clean and brimming with hops. Big time Nelson saturation with tropical dankness and lychee coming through in spades. Supporting hits of pine and orange crush citrus bring depth to the palate, with a medium and welcome bitterness present right the way through. To finish, a mouthcoating Nelson saturation will keep you coming back for more right away. Would you like Fries with that?

items.badge_description: Hoppy International Beer Day! Beer is the common thread that connects us worldwide, bringing people together in a unique way. And beer has played a significant role in shaping countless of our most cherished memories. If there is one thing we've learned along the way: Beer is best when shared with others. Join us in recognizing remarkable breweries worldwide by unlocking the fresh 2026 International Beer Day Badge. And don't forget to follow us on Instagram @untappd so that you never miss the next badge drop!

Hoppy IPA Day! Did you know that, since our inception in 2010, our hoppy lil’ community has checked in over 400 million IPAs? That’s a seriously staggering amount of hops!⁠ Today, we celebrate the hoppiest of days with the hoppiest of badges—the 2026 IPA Day Badge.

Looking for more kick than a session beer, but want to be able to stay for a few rounds? You have to keep it in the middle. That's 355 beers with an ABV greater than 5% and less than 10%.  Try 5 more for Level 72!
We believe in IPA and you should too. You certainly have a taste for the hops! That's 215 different IPAs. Try 5 more for Level 44! Want to learn more about this badge? Check out our podcast
Do you come from the land down under, where beer does flow, and men chunder? That's at least 65 different beers from Australia. Try 5 more for Level 14.
